title: Fredo Job Stills
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Fredo Job · the snow shot moving
heading: The Fredo Job: clips
intro: Your stills, now moving (Omni 1.2 Flash, 8 s each; the cut uses about 3 s of each). Every frame had two ways to move: both were made, or the post-only one is shown as a rough Premiere move. Claude's pick is marked and goes ahead; overrule any with Pick or a note. Words and prices (10p, 39p, the savings) go in later.

sections.lede: Your snow pick (the shovelled ring), animated two ways. The name goes on the empty snow below from the logo file when we edit.

groups.title: 7. The logo in the snow
groups.line: Quiet and cold after the job.

opts.warn: The flakes show mostly against the dark shopfronts at the top

opts.label: b: a gust of powder, the lamp flickers

sections.lede: Masks have no mouths, so the crew speak over the picture. One voice reads the lines we have: Jack's "Like butter." and the shorts list's "It was 10p when we started planning." (not ruled). The pitch and the way-out lines are still blank. Eight British voices from Google's library, read plain.

sections.h: Round 7: the logo in the snow
sections.lede: Jack: "lets make one in the snow". Four ways of making the mark in snow (a sealed writer, real Unsplash snow photos), two takes each. The name goes on in the empty lower third afterwards, from the real logo files, never Flow's letters. Beat 3's line is now "like butter".
